blocks.text: Capacitors are used in various household appliances such as electric fans, water drawing motors, washing machines refrigerators, flashguns, computer keyboards, touchscreens etc. We will describe here a few of them with some detail.

blocks.alt: Left: wiring of a fan motor. Supply terminals N and L. From the common point on N the running coil (an outer ring of coil springs) goes round to L; the starting coil (an inner ring) is joined by red leads, with a can-shaped capacitor on the L side. Labels: Common, Capacitor, Starting Coil, Running Coil. Right: a three-blade ceiling fan (top) and the fan motor stator, a ring of copper windings round a central shaft (bottom).
